ABModel

class ABModel(hierarchy_names: list[str], hierarchy_rw_distributions: list[tuple[float, float]], agent_opinion_rw: tuple[float, float] = (0.0, 0.1), iterations: int = 100, silencing_threshold: float = 0.95, silencing_link: tuple[str, float] = ('', 0.0), negation_threshold: float = 0.999, negation_link: tuple[str, float] = ('', 0.0), radicalisation_threshold: float = 0.99, radicalisation_link: tuple[str, float] = ('', 0.0), suppress_warnings: bool = False, print_interval: int = 10, debug: bool = False, visualise: bool = True, visualisation_dir: str = '', vis_aggregation_method: str = 'median', checkpointing: bool = True, init_graphs: bool = False, parameters_to_track: list[str] | None = None, save_dir: str = '', data_file: str = '', model_id: str = '')[source]

Bases: object

An agent-based model class that is capable of handling multiple layers that affect agent behaviour.

Parameters:

  • hierarchy_names (list[str]) – The names of all social hierarchies that will exist in the model.

  • hierarchy_rw_distributions (list[tuple[float, float]]) – (mean, variance) parameters used for random walk effects within each hierarchy.

  • agent_opinion_rw (tuple[float, float], optional) – Shared (mean, variance) parameters used for stochastic opinion changes across all agents at each timestep.

  • iterations (int, optional) – The number of iterations that the model will run for.

  • silencing_threshold (float, optional) – A threshold that, when surpassed by agents, will cause them to cease expressing their opinions in a given hierarchy.

  • silencing_link (tuple[str, float], optional) – The link function to apply to the silencing threshold, and the link value to use.

  • negation_threshold (float, optional) – A threshold that, when surpassed by agents, will cause their opinion to become its additive inverse.

  • negation_link (tuple[str, float], optional) – The link function to apply to the negation threshold, and the link value to use.

  • radicalisation_threshold (float, optional) – A threshold that determines how strong of an absolute opinion an agent must hold before they begin to consider becoming radicalised.

  • radicalisation_link (tuple[str, float], optional) – The link function to apply to the radicalisation threshold, and the link value to use.

  • suppress_warnings (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if non-critical runtime warnings should be suppressed.

  • print_interval (int, optional) – The iteration interval at which the model’s logger should be printing detailed variable reports.

  • debug (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if additional developer statistics should be tracked and reported during runtime.

  • visualise (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the model should visualise emergent behaviour in real time.

  • visualisation_dir (str, optional) – The path to a directory in which all of this model’s visualiser outputs should be saved to.

  • vis_aggregation_method (str, optional) – The aggregation method that should be used when relevant for visualisation (i.e. “median”, “mean”, etc.).

  • checkpointing (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the model’s progress should be saved at the end of each iteration (useful in case of interrupted runtimes).

  • init_graphs (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if empty graphs should be initialised with the input hierarchy information.

  • parameters_to_track (list[str], optional) – The names of initial model parameters that should be tracked and recorded by the logger.

  • save_dir (str, optional) – The path to a directory in which all of this model’s non-logger data should be saved to.

  • data_file (str, optional) – The path to which the logger’s data should be saved to after iterations are run.

  • model_id (str, optional) – A unique ID assigned to this model to make it referencable amongst other models.

Methods

add_agent

Add a single new Agent to the model's AgentSet, returning its index within the AgentSet.

add_agents

Add new Agents to the Model's AgentSet.

add_agents_to_hierarchy

A helper function that can directly add a collection of agents to a specific hierarchy in the model's graph set.

add_base_graph_edges

A function that takes a Graph object and adds all of its weighted edges to the model's base graph.

add_graph

Add a new Graph to the Model's GraphSet.

add_graphs

Add new Graphs to the Model's GraphSet.

add_relationships_to_hierarchy

A helper function that can directly add relationships to a specific hierarchy in the model's graph set.

apply_link_functions

Apply all relevant parameter link functions as needed.

calculate_aggregate_opinion

Calculates the aggregate network opinion by iterating over each Agent in the model.

calculate_density

Calculate the density of the entire network.

calculate_interdependence

Calculate the layer interdependence; a measure of how much impact a specific layer has in the overall social network.

calculate_interdependences

A helper function that allows for multiprocessing of calculate_interdependence().

calculate_layers_polarisation

Calculate the polarisation of the opinion climate within each hierarchy by calling each graph's calculate_polarisation() method.

calculate_navigability

Calculate the difficulty of navigating from an arbitrary node \(s\) in some layer \(a\) to another arbitrary node \(t\) in some layer \(b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) may or may not be the same layer.

calculate_radicalisation_logodds

Calculates the log odds of an Agent being radicalised within the model.

generate_agents

Randomly generates a number of Agent objects.

generate_graphs

Randomly generates graphs for the given social hierarchy names using the specified method.

get_base_indices_from_edge

A helper function for the base graph that takes in a GraphEdge object from a hierarchy graph and transforms the node indices from hierarchy graph indices to the respective index of the Agent objects in the model's AgentSet.

get_tracked_parameters

A getter function that checks for any explicitly tracked model parameters, and forms a return accordingly.

init_base_graph

Iterates over all the relationships in the existing social hierarchies and creates corresponding edges within the model's base graph.

iterate

Handles the main model iteration loop.

iteration_opinion_calculation

A helper function that calculates the per-agent, per-hierarchy changes to opinions for the iteration, returning all necessary information for iteration_opinion_changes() to apply the opinion changes.

iteration_opinion_changes

A helper function for iterate that simply applies all agent opinion changes and then checks for radicalisation.

layers_polarisation_multi

A helper function that allows for multiprocessing of calculate_layers_polarisation().

load_model

Loads a model and all its components which have been saved following the processes in the save_model() function.

logger_debug_iteration

A helper function that handles the iteration of the logger's debugging component.

logger_iteration

Calculate any relevant aggregate statistics and then pass these to the logger's iteration() function to be stored.

override_current_iteration

A setter function that overrides the model's current iteration value with a new one.

save_model

Saves the model's GraphSet and AgentSet objects, including all objects recursively contained.

set_agent_opinion_rw

A setter function that changes the model's agent_opinion_rw attribute.

set_checkpointing

A setter function that changes the model's checkpointing flag.

set_data_file

A setter function that changes the path to which the final data file should be written.

set_hierarchy_information

A setter function that adds a new entry into the model's hierarchy information attribute.

set_max_iterations

A setter function that changes the model's max iterations attribute.

set_model_id

A setter function that changes the model's unique ID.

set_negation_threshold

A setter function that changes the model's negation threshold.

set_radicalisation_threshold

A setter function that changes the model's radicalisation threshold.

set_save_dir

A setter function that changes the model's save directory.

set_silencing_threshold

A setter function that changes the model's silencing threshold.

set_suppress_warnings

A setter function that changes the model's suppress warnings flag.

set_visualisation_dir

A setter function that changes the model's visualisation directory.

set_visualise

A setter function that changes the model's visualise flag.

step

Steps the model forward one iteration.

track_model_parameters

Note specific model parameters that should be tracked by the logger, and included in the logger's output file.

update

Updates the agents' internal states to match the model step.

update_base_graph

Iterates over all the social hierarchy graphs and checks for pending edge changes.

update_multi

A helper function that allows for multiprocessing of the update() function.
